summary: Compare each identity-fix candidate with the audited frame: is the identity fault gone, and did nothing else break?
logs: 54 panels: 41 accept, 13 retry, 0 keep old; 0 groups failed

items.notes: The new stud is a small round gold bead with a bright highlight, sitting on the lower lobe. Nothing hangs from it, but it is slightly rounder than the flat stud on the sheet. The chin stubble is softened, and Nagoji's face, hair, moustache, bandaged wrists, Ibrahim (scar on his LEFT cheek, hand on pocket), the horses and the coast all match the old frame.

The new stud is a round gold disc flush on the lobe with nothing below it. It is a little larger than lentil size but reads as a stud at the 3.0 in print width. The curly mass gathered at the back of the crown was there in the old frame too, so it is not a change. Ibrahim, the guards, the raised hand, the gate, the conch standard and Nagoji's clean forearms and bandaged hands are unchanged.

The new stud is a small round gold ball at the bottom of the lobe. It has no post, hoop or bead below it, but it is rounder than flat and its lower edge sits at the edge of the lobe. Light jaw stubble is still faintly visible (NOTE level). Width changed from 2149 to 2148 px, which is negligible. The groom, horse, extended clean forearm with bandaged hand, pillars and backwater are unchanged.

This is a clean fix: a tiny gold stud flush on the lobe, and the stubble is mostly smoothed. Ibrahim, the distant Varma (turban and peacock crest), Ramayyan, the guards and courtiers are unchanged. As in the old frame, the namam on the distant Varma cannot be made out at this size (pre-existing, NOTE).

The new stud is a tiny dot on the lobe with nothing hanging, and the lobe's lower edge is restored. Varma's face, namam, pearl drops, moustache, necklaces and gesture are unchanged, and so are Ramayyan, the guard and the hall. As in the old frame, the black hair showing below Varma's turban behind his ears looks somewhat wavy rather than sleek (pre-existing, NOTE).

This is a clean fix: a tiny gold stud flush on the lobe, and the jaw and chin stubble is smoothed to clean-shaven. The moustache, open mouth, eyes and curly hair are kept. The raised bandaged hand, resting hand, lamp, pillar, sea view and Chaul bastion flashback all match the old frame.

The hanging gold bead and hook are fully gone at 8x and the hair, jaw and neck behind them are cleanly repainted, but no stud was added: the visible (screen-left) earlobe is now bare instead of carrying the tiny flat gold stud. Nothing hangs, so it no longer echoes Varma's drops; the missing stud is NOTE level. Face, thick curled moustache, clean chin, loose curly hair, cream shirt, bandaged hands, pose, lamp, padre and musketeer stain, and Varma's hand with the bead bracelet on the spear are unchanged. No brand visible on either forearm.

The gold teardrop and hook are gone; a small round gold stud now sits on the lobe with nothing below it. It is slightly domed rather than flat (NOTE). Closed eyes, face, moustache, curly hair, cream shirt with no sash, bandaged hands, the topknot guard (not a double), the burning-quay and horse stain, lamp and sea view are unchanged. Faint chin stipple is the same as in the old frame (NOTE).

Both hanging teardrops are removed; each lobe now carries a tiny round gold stud flush on the lobe, nothing hanging. Hair outline strands were lightly redrawn but the shape of the hair is the same. Face, expression, moustache, shirt, bandaged hands, guards (crown topknots, straight hair, not doubles), lamp, sea view and the blurred foreground figure are unchanged. The near guard's small ear stud in the old frame is less visible in the new one, which is negligible.

Both drops are gone. Screen-left lobe is now bare; screen-right lobe has a tiny gold stud. At 12x that stud is a slightly elongated stub whose lower tip just reaches the lobe edge, but at placed size (3.62 in at 300 ppi) it reads as a dot on the lobe with nothing hanging (NOTE). Raised hand, inner forearm (no brand), bandaged wrists, guards and pillars are unchanged. Pre-existing, not introduced by this edit: the blurred foreground figure at screen left (presumably Varma from behind) wears a large gold ball drop earring and shows a dark wavy lock, where his marker is a pearl drop and straight hair; worth a separate look.

The round gold ball and loop are gone; a tiny stud about 3 px wide sits flush on the screen-left lobe and the other ear is bare, as asked. The stud's core reads pale cream at 18x, so it could read as a tiny pearl rather than gold. At this size that is NOTE level only. Chin and jaw stubble stipple is clearly reduced. Hands gripping the dhoti, shirt, courtiers, guards, pillars and sea view are unchanged.

Nagoji: both hanging drops are removed; the screen-left lobe is bare and the screen-right lobe has a tiny flush stud with a pale highlight (NOTE). Varma (back view): the bushy curly mass is replaced by straight, sleek black hair tucked under the turban at the nape, and his earring is now a white pearl drop. Turban, peacock crest, cloth and seat are unchanged. With the curls gone, his gold bead necklace is now fully visible around the neck, which follows directly from the edit. Courtiers, guards, bandaged hands, harbour and ships are unchanged.

The hanging round gold drop and its hook are gone; at zoom the neck skin and curls behind where it hung are cleanly filled. The replacement is a small round gold stud about 9 x 7 frame px, sitting inside the lower front edge of the left earlobe with nothing hanging below it, matching the commander sheet stud. It is a touch bright and domed rather than perfectly flat, and sits at the lobe's bottom edge rather than its centre; acceptable at print scale. The chin stipple is softened so the chin reads clean-shaven, and the thick curled moustache, profile, eyebrow, eye and long loose curly black hair are unchanged. Outside the ear and chin the frame shows only a light whole-image re-render (slightly smoother skin and cloth texture). Composition, framing, the lamps, the mat, the seated and standing guards (faces unchanged), both bandaged hands (finger counts unchanged) and the empty rafter space for balloons all match the old frame. A faint vein or muscle line runs along the outer extended forearm in both old and new; it is not a brand and is unchanged. No text, gore or limb faults.

items.remaining: Left earlobe (frame about x378, y260 to 267): the second, larger gold bead still hangs directly below the flush stud, so the earring still reads as a two-bead drop at zoom, the same as v02. Item 1 of the correction was not applied. The brand part of the fault is fixed: the starburst patch and the white scar are gone from the outer left forearm, wrist and back of the hand, and the jaw now reads clean-shaven.
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate (v03) only at Nagoji's left earlobe, at about frame x370 to 386, y255 to 274. Remove the lower, larger gold bead that hangs below the lobe, at about x377, y267. Paint the jaw shadow, neck skin and black curls behind it to match what surrounds them. Leave a single small flat gold stud flush on the lobe at about x378, y260, with nothing hanging below it. Keep everything else exactly as in v03: the clean-shaven jaw, the plain outer left forearm draped over the grey horse's neck, the unmarked right forearm in the straw, the rust-red turban, the curly hair with first grey at the temples, the thick curled moustache, the cream tunic, red sash, trousers and boots, the horse, the two grooms in the doorway, the slatted stable and the dawn light.
items.notes: In v03 the outer left forearm shows only faint pale vein highlights, with one short pale tick near the wrist. They cannot be seen at print scale and do not read as a scar. The right forearm hair is slightly smoother than in v02. Composition, grooms (not doubles) and costume are unchanged.

items.remaining: The regeneration repeats the fault from a new angle. The LEFT hand is still palm down, with the back of the hand, the knuckles, the back-of-hand tendons and the thumbnail (at the right) facing the camera. The inner forearm, wrist crease and inner-wrist tendons the correction asked for are not visible. The forearm face we see runs on from the back of the hand and is hairy over its whole length, so it is the outer (extensor) face. The round puckered brand (about x610, y650) and the long white scar (about x900, y540 to x720, y810) sit on that outer face. The brand is also up near the elbow, beside the sleeve, not a hand's width above the wrist. The brand's shape itself is correct (round, ridged, no symbol or letters).
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate (v03) only on Nagoji's LEFT hand and the skin of his left forearm. Turn the hand palm up. The back of the hand rests on the grey neck under the black mane, the open palm with its creases faces the camera, the fingers curl loosely into the mane, and the thumb lies on the upper side of the hand toward the top of the frame. The forearm face the camera sees is then the INNER forearm. Paint that face smooth and nearly hairless, with the wrist crease and the inner-wrist tendons visible at the wrist. Keep the same small, round, pale puckered brand of raised ridges, with no letters, no glyphs and no cross, but move it down to a hand's width above the wrist crease. Keep the long thin white scar beside it, running from the wrist toward the elbow. No knuckles, back-of-hand tendons or nails may face the camera. Keep the cream sleeve pushed up to the elbow, the grey neck and coat, the black mane, the horse's ear, the straw, the stable and the warm dawn light exactly as they are. If the edit cannot turn the hand over, regenerate the insert with this palm-up pose instead. Flag it to the author, because it replaces the script's 'flat on the grey neck'.
items.notes: The upper third of v03 is a fairly sharp, bright slatted wall and thatch, not the soft, low-detail area asked for, so the two caption boxes may sit on busy detail. Hand anatomy is sound and there is no text.

The outer left forearm and the back of the hand are now plain skin from elbow to wrist, and the white looping curl is fully gone. The face, the loose solid-black curls with no grey, the moustache and the flush studs on both ears are unchanged. Revathi, the wall, the courtyard and the verandah are unchanged. Both v02 and v03 show faint shading on the jaw and a small pale dot on the cheek beside the nose (NOTE). The rib binding barely shows above the high-wrapped dhoti in both frames.

The branching white scar and the puckered strip are gone from the outer left forearm, and Revathi's two hands on the bandage tail are untouched. The faint stipple on Nagoji's jaw is still there, the same as in v02 (NOTE; this correction did not ask to smooth it). The flush stud, the black curls with no grey and Revathi's face and jewellery are unchanged.

The ladder scar and the pale dashes are gone from the draped outer left forearm, the wrist and the back of the hand, and the jaw stipple has been smoothed to clean-shaven. The gold stud is a small round bead sitting flush on the lobe with nothing below it, a little rounder than 'tiny flat' and the same as in v02. The faint thin pale line on the planted right forearm is still there, the same as in v02 and invisible at print size (NOTE).

The seal-like disc and the long white scar are gone from the crossed outer left forearm, and only plain skin with its hair texture remains. The small pale mark on the back of the right hand is gone too. The jaw stipple has been smoothed to clean-shaven. The flush stud, the curls, Revathi's profile, the dark room and the barred window are unchanged.

Edit was clean. The pale patch and the long white scar are gone from the outer face of the foreground left forearm, which now shows plain brown skin, hair and veins. The grey at the temple and sideburn is now black curls. The stud is still tiny and flush, the chin clean and the moustache thick. The joined hands, Revathi, the window and the door are pixel-identical. Costume drift is unchanged: he still wears the long-sleeved cream shirt instead of the convalescent bare chest and shoulder cloth.

Varma now reads clearly as Varma. He has straight, sleek jet-black hair, a thin waxed upturned moustache, the white namam with a red centre line, a pearl drop at the visible left ear and a clean chin, so he is no longer a Nagoji double. The single knot sits high, behind and above the left ear. That matches the sheet's left-profile placement but sits toward the upper back of the head. The correction asked for a narrow linen dressing on his left shoulder, but no distinct one is drawn; only the white upper cloth covers that shoulder. His cloth has gold borders where the script says plain. His near foot wears a dark shoe in the stirrup, while the far foot, seen past the horse's chest, is bare. Nagoji has a tiny flush stud, a clean chin, no grey and plain forearms with no marks. Kayal is a bay with a black mane and no white markings; only a faint highlight shows on the forehead. The white-turbaned escort riders have heavy moustaches and curls, but they are generic and do not read as Nagoji doubles. Lettering is captions only, so no tails.

items.remaining: At zoom, the gold drop under Nagoji's visible ear is smaller (about 4 px instead of 8 by 11 px) but still there. It is a separate gold bead sitting below the earlobe outline against the neck, with the dark piercing dot still visible higher on the lobe. So it still reads as a small hanging drop, not a flush stud.
items.correction: Edit the NEW frame (v02) only at Nagoji's visible ear. Erase the small gold bead that still sits below the bottom edge of the earlobe, and repaint that spot as plain neck skin with the same jaw shadow and curly black hair behind it. Then put one tiny flat gold stud directly on the dark piercing point on the lobe, wholly inside the lobe outline, with no gold extending below the lobe edge and nothing hanging from it. Keep everything else in this frame exactly as it is: the rust-red turban, curly black hair, thick curled moustache, clean chin, no grey, the folded arms and forearm patch, the cream tunic, red sash, talwar and boots, De Lannoy tracing rectangles, the firing line, the walls and the sea.
items.notes: The patch on the folded left forearm still shows a pinkish crisscross line texture, as in the old frame. It is not new, but a later pass could soften it toward a blurred, puckered patch. The whole frame has slight regeneration drift in the musket smoke and the dust rectangles, but the composition is unchanged.

The hanging gold ball is gone. Only a small stud remains, inside the lobe outline. Varma, Ramayyan, De Lannoy, the hands, the spear and the bastion are unchanged. Existing NOTE items are still there: Varma's medium-heavy moustache, since the optional slimming was not applied, and the wavy black locks at his nape under the turban. Both still sit close to Nagoji's look, but the turban, crest, namam and pearl drops keep the two men distinct.

The hanging ball is removed. A small gold stud sits on the lobe, with nothing below it. The folded forearms, boots, De Lannoy, the coat pile and the blue-vested men are unchanged apart from negligible re-render noise.

The polished ball below the lobe is gone. A small stud sits at the lobe tip, with nothing hanging below it. The face, turban, clean chin, crossed arms with sleeves down, De Lannoy and the conch banner are unchanged. There is minor re-render drift in the musket shapes and headbands of the infantry line on the right; the poses and composition stay the same.

At zoom both crossed forearms are now plain brown skin with veins and muscle shading. The pink starburst near the left elbow and the pale band across the right forearm are gone, with no leftover outline. Diff shows only re-encode edge noise elsewhere; musketeers, guards, wall, sea and drill ground are pixel-identical in content. Head unchanged from OLD: rust-red turban, thick curled moustache, clean chin with light shading, curly black hair. The silver at the temple is a strong streak rather than 'faint first grey' (allowed in ch16, NOTE). The ear stud is a small domed gold bead seated on the lower lobe with nothing hanging below it; slightly rounder than the sheet's flat stud, unchanged from OLD (NOTE).

The hanging gold ball below the lobe is gone; at 6x zoom there is one small flat gold stud set on the lobe with nothing below it. Stubble stipple on cheek, jaw and chin is largely removed; only a few sparse pore-like dots remain on the jaw, reading as clean-shaven. Turban, moustache, half smile, curls, tunic, sash and talwar kept; both visible forearms are unmarked. Dhanaji (face, beard, hoop, raised hand, quilted tunic) and the left half of the strip are unchanged. Drift: everything right of about x1100 (Nagoji plus the right background: guards, watch platform, torches, rifle rack) is shifted about 15 to 17 px to the right (under 1% of the width) with identical content and no visible seam; the red-turbaned guard on the platform at the far right edge is now cropped a little more by the frame. Grey at the temple is a strong silver streak (allowed in ch16).

At 2x zoom the top (left) forearm now carries no puckered patch and no diagonal white scar; the area is plain brown skin matching the veins, hair and dusk light of the rest of the arm, and the right forearm below is also unmarked. Diff shows only re-encode edge noise elsewhere: De Lannoy's face, hair ribbon, coat and open hand, the cannon, the bastion, the inlet, boats and palms are unchanged. Nagoji's face, rust-red turban, flush gold stud, clean chin, curled moustache and curls unchanged. Grey at the temple is a fairly strong silver patch (allowed in ch16).

Ear: the hanging gold bead is gone, but the edit also took the stud, so the visible earlobe is now bare. That is minor drift from the 'tiny flush gold stud' look and is not a hanging earring. Forearm: the white lightning and vein pattern and the starburst are gone completely, leaving plain brown skin with muscle and vein shading and no visible brand. That is allowed because the forearm is palm down. The optional hair tidy was applied: the long loose curls behind the neck are shortened, with a few curls still at the nape. The chin is smoother, with only faint shading. The skin rendering is slightly softer overall. Composition, face, hands, chain, knife, courtyard and kalari boys are unchanged.

The dark outlined hook or spiral glyph and its centre dot are gone. In their place is a soft pale streaky patch of scar ridges in skin tones, with no outline and no symbol. At native size it reads as faint old burned skin. The patch still sits on the upper forearm nearer the elbow, not a hand's width above the wrist (placement NOTE). The long white scar keeps its small feather-like side ticks, unchanged from the old frame. Head, flush stud, grey temples, clean chin, runner and courtyard are unchanged.

The engraved circle, eye, rays and vine lines are gone. The brand is now a soft-edged, round, pale mottled patch with no outline, about a hand's width above the wrist, and it reads as an old burn. The long scar running through it still has a few short perpendicular ticks, like a stitched scar, instead of the plain line that was asked for. One tick near mid-forearm makes a tiny crossbar, but at native size it reads as scar texture, not a cross (NOTE). Varma is unchanged from the old frame: turban, crest, namam, pearl drops and necklaces. The dark curls at his nape and his heavier moustache remain the earlier NOTE-level drift. Nagoji's head, stud and chin are unchanged.

items.remaining: At 3x and 6x zoom, the inner spiral is mostly gone, but the mark is still a round disc with a rim of short radiating rays and a dark dot at its centre. The white scar still flows out of its lower edge. At native size it reads plainly as a pale sunburst or wheel sign on the raised left forearm. It is only paler than the old mark, not a different kind of mark.
items.correction: Edit the NEW frame. Change only Nagoji's raised LEFT forearm (right of frame, the hand cupping his chin with the back of the hand toward the viewer). Erase the whole round mark on the forearm: the pale disc, every short radiating tick around its rim, and the dark dot at its centre. Repaint that area as plain, even, lamp-lit forearm skin, with its existing hair and muscle shading and no lighter spot. In this pose the inner forearm, where the brand sits, faces his chest and is out of sight, so draw no brand at all. Keep the long thin white scar only as one simple straight pale line running from near the wrist toward the elbow, starting and ending in plain skin, with no ring, burst, branch or knot anywhere along it. Change nothing else: keep the low angle, the brass lamp, the single memory stain of the Deccan fort wall with cannon, the shelves and pillared doorway, and Nagoji's face, topknot, grey temples, flush gold stud, moustache, chain, knife, mundu and pose.
items.notes: Head, ear stud, chin, chain, knife and setting are unchanged.

items.remaining: The crisp rayed disc and the keyhole figure are gone. At 3x and 5x zoom, though, the replacement is a pale blotch with a frilly, spiked rim, a faint inner ring, and a few soft points radiating outward. The white scar runs straight into it like a stem. At native panel size this still reads as a small pale sunburst or flower on a stem near the elbow, not as a shapeless patch. It is softer than before, but it is not clearly gone.
items.correction: Edit the NEW frame. Change only Nagoji's LEFT forearm (image right, resting on his knee). Remove the pale spiked blotch below the elbow completely, with its frilly pointed rim, faint inner ring and radiating points, and blend it back into plain forearm skin with its hair and muscle shading. Paint the brand lower, about a hand's width above the wrist, as a small, slightly oval, softly blurred patch of skin a shade lighter and faintly shiny, with smooth, rounded, irregular edges. It must have no points, spikes, rays, rim, ring, inner shape or dot. Keep the long thin white scar as one simple pale line running beside the patch, not into it or out of it, from near the wrist toward the elbow, with no branches. Change nothing else: keep his face, moustache, clean chin, tiny flush gold stud, grey temples, crown knot and curls, silver chain and medallion, mundu and shoulder cloth, conch knife, seated pose, lamp, shelves, doorway and lighting.
items.notes: Head, stud, chain, medallion, knife and setting are unchanged. The new frame is better than the old one but still not clean.

items.remaining: The white cross-and-branch glyph on the forearm is fully gone, leaving plain hairy forearm skin, so that part is fixed. At 8x and 14x zoom, the ear is not fixed. The edit removed the small upper stud and kept the round gold bead. That bead sits below the outline of the earlobe, against the jaw shadow. At native size it still reads as a gold drop hanging under his visible right ear.
items.correction: Edit the NEW frame. Change only Nagoji's visible ear (his right ear, image left of his face, midground beside Padmini). Remove the round gold bead that sits below the earlobe, and repaint that spot as the jaw and neck shadow and the dark hair behind it, with nothing gold below the lobe. Keep the left forearm exactly as it is now (plain skin, no mark). items.notes: Padmini's small forehead dot seems to have faded out in the new frame (minor drift). Her face is otherwise unchanged. The second Nair officer is unchanged, and the earlier note about him still stands: grey at the temple and a moustache, but in profile, without chain or shoulder cloth, so he is not a double.

At zoom the dark ring and spiral below the elbow are gone, and the skin there is plain and even. A diff of the old and new frames shows that only that strip of the arm changed. Head, stud (flush, nothing hanging), clean chin, moustache, topknot with grey temples, the knife, Revathi and the verandah are all unchanged. The long white scar is still on the outer face of the bent-back forearm, as the correction said to keep it. The bible puts it on the inner LEFT forearm, so this is NOTE-level drift only.

At zoom the white-outlined trefoil circle and the long drawn white line are both gone. The left forearm is plain skin with matching tone and arm hair. The hand is intact: four fingers and a thumb, with a little less vein detail on the back of the hand. The diff touches only that forearm column. Head, flush stud, grey temples, topknot, knife, Padmini and the gate are all unchanged. The moustache is a little less full than the sheet's in both the old and new frames, which is not a new problem.

items.new_faults: Broken (mirrored) hand. The arm comes in from frame right, so in this front view of the chest it is his LEFT arm. The hand on it is drawn as a RIGHT hand. The palm faces the viewer (creases, thumb mound and pale palm scars are visible), the wrist is at frame right, the fingers point to frame left, and the thumb sits on the UPPER edge of the palm. For a left hand seen palm-on in that orientation, the thumb has to be on the lower edge; the sheet's LEFT FOREARM view shows the correct handedness. This is an anatomically impossible hand on a tight insert whose subject is the hand.
items.correction: Edit the NEW frame, and edit only Nagoji's hand. It is drawn as a right hand (palm toward the viewer, wrist at frame right, thumb along the upper edge of the palm), but it is on his LEFT arm, which enters from frame right. Redraw it as an anatomically LEFT hand and keep the palm facing the viewer. Put the thumb and the fleshy thumb mound on the LOWER edge of the palm, the side nearer the mundu, with the thumb curling up to press the chain links from below. The four fingers curl down over the chain from above, the index finger nearest the thumb at the bottom and the little finger at the top. Keep the faint pale scars across the palm and draw none on the back of the hand. Keep the wrist and the whole forearm exactly as they are, with the pale puckered brand patch and the long thin white scar on the visible inner side. Also keep unchanged: the plain silver link chain with no medallion, the bare chest, the shoulder cloth and mundu at the edges, the warm dusk light and the framing. Add no lettering.
items.notes: The identity fault is fixed. The visible face of the forearm continues from the palm, so it is the inner side, and the brand there is a pale puckered patch with no shape or letters. The long scar runs beside it and nothing is drawn on the back of the hand. Drift: the brand sits only about half a hand's width above the wrist crease; the long scar appears to run on from a palm scar across the wrist; chain links run through the top band meant to stay low-detail for the caption; and the new frame is 1536x1024, while the old was 1374x1145, so the page layout may need a re-crop.

At zoom the raised coiled spiral and the crossing white line are gone from the left forearm, which is now plain skin with arm hair and matching shading. The hand is intact. The diff is concentrated in that forearm column. Head, flush stud with nothing hanging, grey temples, topknot with gold tie, moustache, clean chin, knife, wind-lifted shoulder cloth, Padmini's shoulder and stick, and the split Deccan and coast background are all unchanged. NOTE-level drift: the back-of-hand veins are slightly softened, and the pepper-vine leaves at the right edge are faintly re-rendered with no change to composition.

Varma's knot sits fairly high on the upper left side of his head (about temple height) rather than tight above the ear. It is clearly on the side, not the crown, and matches the sheet's front view. His moustache is medium weight but clearly waxed and upturned. The namam is now a white U with a red centre line. Nagoji's head, stud, chain and the background figures are unchanged; the diff shows only resampling along the mundu and chain edges.

items.remaining: Varma's knot is now a rounded bun sticking out from the BACK of his skull, behind his visible right ear (image left). He faces up and to the right, so his left side is the far side, and a knot at the back is a listed hard fault. Nagoji still has the small gold bead hanging below his lobe stud, which breaks the nothing-hanging rule. Fixed: Varma's hair is now straight and sleek, his moustache thin and waxed, and the namam with its red centre has been added. Nagoji's left forearm is now plain skin with no streak, splash or wrist band.
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate. Change only these two small areas and keep everything else exactly as drawn: the stair, the torch, the heir, both bodies, Varma's sleek straight hair, his thin waxed moustache, namam and pearl drop, and Nagoji's head and cleaned forearm. (1) Varma (right) faces up and to the right, so we see his RIGHT ear. Remove the rounded bun that sticks out from the back of his skull behind that ear. Close the back of his head with a smooth, sleek, rounded hairline combed straight back, with nothing at the back or the nape. His knot is on the LEFT side above his left ear, which is the far side in this view. Show at most a small rounded tip of it peeking just above the far upper edge of his head, over his far temple (to the image right of the top of his head), or hide it entirely. (2) Nagoji (left): erase the small gold bead hanging below his earlobe stud. Leave only the tiny flat gold stud flush on the lobe, with bare skin below it.
items.notes: Nagoji's chain of office is still a bead strand rather than fine links (costume drift, unchanged from the old frame). The diff speckles on the wet stair are highlight noise only.

items.remaining: Two small dark CURLY tufts of the old hair are left behind Varma's neck. One sits below and behind his right ear (image left, beside the jaw). The other sits below and behind his left ear (image right, under the pearl drop) and reaches down toward the shoulder. They read as curly hair on the neck, against the straight-and-sleek rule. Fixed: the crown bun and loose shoulder-length curls are gone, the hair is combed sleek into a small knot on his left side above the left ear, the moustache is thin and waxed, and the namam with its red centre has been added. The mark between Nagoji's brows has been removed.
items.correction: Edit the NEW candidate. Change only Varma's nape. Erase the two small dark curly tufts visible behind his neck. One is below and behind his right ear (image left, beside his jaw). items.notes: The ringed emblem and the white scar line are both gone from the near (left) forearm, leaving plain skin with veins and tendons. The hands on the dagger, Nagoji's head (topknot, grey, moustache, flush stud, clean chin), the chaver and the courtyard are unchanged.
